header: L3 · The maintainer three years from now · sonnet
verdict: The round-8 write pass resolves the L3 findings it took on as stated (28 checked, 28 resolved as stated; 11 of them by direct reading, the rest by sampling the cited sentence or row). The largest remaining gap is that the pass introduced a few self-contradictions of the rules it wrote: the spec names plan tasks against 12.5, 04 4.4 is both a link and a test input, and a hand-written page is listed as a generate target.

findings.defect: The write pass cites plan tasks inside the spec (T021 in 03's opening, T008 in 04 4.4) although 12 12.5 says the spec names no plan task; and 04 4.4 says that from T008 the section is a link to docs/reference/errors.md while T008's acceptance has a test that reads the rows of 04 4.4 and compares them to the table.
findings.scenario: T008 lands: the test reads 04 4.4 rows, so the section can never become the promised link; or the section becomes a link and the test has nothing to read. Meanwhile a plan renumbering leaves 03 and 04 pointing at the wrong task, and a docs check of 12.5 (if written) fails.
findings.change: Replace both task ids by the event ('the pull request that lands the generator of project.v1', 'the pull request that lands the error table'); choose one end state for 4.4 (the table is the source and 4.4 is a link, with T008's test dropped) and make T008's acceptance say so.

findings.defect: 04 4.1 now defines an error id as RJ-<nnn> with a separate slug, but 03 calls the slugs 'the error id' (format-newer, upstream-shape, manifest-size).
findings.scenario: A new reader greps for the error id format-newer, finds RJ-311 in 04 4.4, and invents a third name; tests that 'assert ids, never message text' are unclear on which spelling to assert.
findings.change: Write 'the error `format-newer` (RJ-311)' in 03, or give 04 4.1 a Vocabulary row for error id and slug.

findings.defect: The resolution of L3-18 makes the issue label 'deferred' the one channel for about 15 human-observed triggers, but nothing creates the label: the issue forms are two (a bug, a catalog gap) and no plan task or check mentions the label.
findings.scenario: An adopter reports a trigger and 'gh issue create --label deferred' fails or the issue is unlabelled; the row's event happened and nobody sees it.
findings.change: Add the label (or a third issue form 'a deferred decision's event') to the task that lands the issue forms, and say so in 12 12.7.

findings.defect: The command-definitions row of 12.3 lists 'the P marker and the appending list of 04 4.1' as generated consumers, while the same section says a hand-written page is never a generate target; 04 4.1 still carries both lists by hand.
findings.scenario: After the dispatcher lands, the appending list in 04 4.1 is a second copy that only the idempotency meta-test could compare, and that test reads the definitions, not the page.
findings.change: Say the lists in 04 are the design input and the generated docs/reference/<command>.md replaces them (the T021 rule of 03), or state the test that compares the page to the definitions.

findings.defect: The deferred tables are 'read at each release-candidate tag' (index) and the dark-code listing is read at that tag too, but the release checklist of 12.2 has no step for either.
findings.scenario: The rc tag is pushed per the checklist; the reading, which is the only detector for about 15 rows, is skipped because no ordered step names it.
findings.change: Add the reading to step 1 of the checklist, with its output (the rows whose event happened).

findings.section: plan (How this page is kept), 12 12.2 (Re-planning), index: Deferred decisions
findings.defect: 12.2 says the plan states no counts, while the plan's 'How this page is kept' still says its counts and traceability rows are kept true by hand; and a deferred row states 'the 19 fixtures' and 'testifylint v1.6.4' in prose, hand-kept facts of the class L3-2 and L3-33 named.
findings.scenario: A contributor trusts one of the two sentences; the fixture count or version drifts at the next lint bump with nothing comparing it.
findings.change: Make the plan's paragraph match 12.2 (derived rows only), and drop the count and version from the deferred row in favour of a pointer to the pin file.

out_of_scope: Pages 00, 07, 08, 09, 11 and 13 were only grepped for L3's findings (the 0.6 move, the J12 and cmux edits, the tested-window and affects checks), not read in the diff. L3-6, L3-16, L3-34 were sampled, not traced to every place. Status operator, L and parked clusters were not re-reported. ADR 0009's 280 lines of replacement text were outlined, not judged.
confidence: Medium: the six findings were verified by grep and reading at the baseline; the 28 resolved verdicts are lower confidence for the items sampled rather than traced in full.
